text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- The government will not be deterresd from pursuing a vigorous programme to develop the country despite criticisms against its leaders for placing too much emphasis on material development, Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said.
-- The general insurance industry has commissioned five task forces and unveiled a masterplan in response to the challenges and opportunities presented by liberalisation,.
